"''My pleasure.|Y-O serves Leia Organa a hors d'oeuvre|audio=Y-O-Leia-KenobiI.flac|}} '''Y-O''',{{Kenobi|Part I}} or '''Why-Oh''',[[Obi-Wan Kenobi 1|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' 1]] was a [[protocol droid]] used by the [[House of Organa]], the royal house of the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]].''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' It had [[Color|blue]] [[sensor]]s and silver plating. In [[9 BBY]],{{KenobiDate|I}} the [[droid]] served at a royal reception{{Kenobi|Part I}} {{AD|Disney+}} in the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan]], during which Y-O offered [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] a tray of [[Foodstuff|hors d'oeuvres]]. Organa took one and thanked the droid, who then moved away from Organa's table before the [[Gender|princess's]] cousin, [[Niano Organa]], mocked her for thanking the droid, which he [[Anti-droid sentiment|considered]] a lower life form. ==Behind the scenes== Y-O was voiced by [[Shelby Young]]{{YouTube|video=jh6v7GxAixA|text=Shelby Young - Princess Leia on Star Wars: The Forces of Destiny on Alicyn's Wonderland S2 E12|channel=@alicynswonderland|name=Alicyn's Wonderland|date=22-06-2022}} and physically portrayed by [[Daniel Bohman]]{{YouTube|video=lzeso78X1Pw|text=Star Wars Obi-Wan Kenobi Discussion With Droid Actor Chris Bartlett|channel=@RebelScumPage|name=Rebel Scum|date=2022-12-02}} in the [[Part I|first episode]] of the [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']] [[Disney+]] television series, which premiered on [[May 27]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|date=2022-05-27|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early. Start streaming the first two episodes on @DisneyPlus TONIGHT at 9PM PT.|archivedate=20220527053945}} Droid performer [[Chris Bartlett]] built the suit for the character. ==Appearances== *{{Kenobi|Part I}} {{1st}} *[[Obi-Wan Kenobi 1|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' 1]] ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Y-O |es=Y-O |fr=Y-O |ja=Y-O |ka=Y-O |nl=Y-O |pl=Y-O |pt=Y-O |tr=Y-O }} [[Category:Droids with unspecified gender programming]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:House of Organa servants]] [[Category:Protocol droids]]
